reason: My manager already handles my deals and takes their cut, so if I book through Collabo too I'm paying 10% on top of 15-20%. With under 5K followers I'm not making enough to give up another slice, and I'd have to clear it with my manager anyway.
objection: Stacked fees. Collabo's 10% plus my manager's cut means close to a third of a small deal is gone, and with only a few brands on there I doubt it brings in work my manager wouldn't find anyway.
would_change_my_mind: If my manager said deals I find on Collabo myself don't count toward their cut, or if it actually showed me brands booking creators my size every week.
